The forward suffered head and chest injuries in a heavy collision with goalkeeper Jesus Owono during a Spanish second division match against FC Andorra on Monday. results.title: Democrats take control of US Congress as voters reject Trump’s Republicans
results.content: President Donald Trump told voters to pretend he was on the ballot in this year’s midterm elections.

results.title: Cocoa farmers hope for March recovery after season starts poorly
results.content: Cocoa farmers hope for a recovery in March harvests after a poor start to the season, driven by heavy rains in some areas and drought in others.

results.title: Afua Asantewaa demands justice for Ghanaian teenager shot dead in New York
results.content: Afua Asantewaa O. Aduonum has called for justice for Javits Badu Nkansah Frimpong, a 15-year-old Ghanaian student who was fatally shot in the Bronx, New York.

results.title: ‘Why not? I wouldn’t have minded’ – Fifi Kwetey on accepting a government role
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey says he would have accepted a government appointment, provided it was not a full-time role that would limit his work for the party.

results.title: Fidelity Bank becomes Ghana’s only bank to achieve 2X Certified Advanced status for gender-smart finance
results.content: Fidelity Bank Ghana has achieved 2X Certified Advanced status, becoming the only bank in Ghana to attain this distinction and reinforcing its commitment to advancing gender-smart finance and women's economic empowerment.

results.title: Asiedu Nketia has earned the right to contest for president — Fifi Kwetey
results.content: The General Secretary of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Fifi Kwetey, has thrown his weight behind the right of the party’s National Chairman, Johnson Asiedu Nketia, to contest the presidency, saying his years of dedicated service to the party make him qualified to seek the highest political office.

results.title: I would accept a government appointment if it’s not full-time – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: National Democratic Congress (NDC) General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey says he would accept a government appointment if it isn't full-time.

results.title: Scandal-hunting will keep NPP in opposition for a long time – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey has warned that the New Patriotic Party (NPP) risks a prolonged stay in opposition if it keeps hunting for scandals to revive its political fortunes.

results.title: Oil edges down as investors await US midterm election results
results.content: Oil prices slipped in early trade on Wednesday as investors awaited US midterm election results and their potential impact on Middle East peace talks, even after industry data showed US crude stocks unexpectedly fell last week.

results.title: Nasara appointees thank National Organiser, pledge support for Bawumia
results.content: Newly appointed officers of the National Nasara Wing of the New Patriotic Party (NPP) have expressed gratitude to the National Nasara Organiser for the confidence reposed in them, pledging to serve with dedication and integrity. Speaking in an interview in Hamburg, Germany, Deputy Secretary in charge of Diaspora Affairs, Mohammed Awal F., conveyed the appreciation on behalf of his fellow appointees.

results.title: Tesla misled South Korean customers about automated-driving tech, consumer group alleges
results.content: Tesla has misled tens of thousands ​of South Korean customers by marketing driver-assistance software that the company knows cannot be legally used in most of its vehicles in the country, according ‌to a complaint an advocacy group plans to file with a consumer protection agency on Thursday.

results.title: Independent auditor to scrutinise Auditor-General’s accounts
results.content: Parliament has taken steps to subject the financial records of the Auditor-General’s Office to independent scrutiny after approving a committee report recommending the appointment of an external auditor to examine its accounts.

results.title: NPP targeting Ablakwa for exposing wrongdoing under Akufo-Addo – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey has accused the New Patriotic Party (NPP) of targeting Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa for exposing alleged wrongdoing under its administration.

results.title: Fifi Kwetey challenges NPP to prove Foreign Affairs Minister stole evacuation funds
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey has challenged the New Patriotic Party (NPP) to prove that Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa stole money meant for evacuating Ghanaians from South Africa.

results.title: Pressure to find scandals against NPP made me quit ranking member role – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey says pressure from his own political camp to find scandals against the NPP at all costs helped drive him to quit his parliamentary ranking member role.

results.title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
results.content: South Africans are voting in highly contested local elections likely to see a haemorrhaging of votes for the country's former ruling party, the African National Congress (ANC).

results.title: From Kumasi, a young Ghanaian woman is stitching a new future for African fashion
results.content: Inside a fashion workshop in Sawaba, a suburb of Kumasi, sewing machines hum as young women work on different garments. Some carefully cut fabric, others operate sewing machines, while a few concentrate on decorating dresses with beads, pearls and stones.

results.title: ‘You can’t be in NDC and expect that you do same thing NPP does’ – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey has warned party members that they cannot repeat the misconduct they accused the NPP of and expect protection.

results.title: No cover-up for NDC wrongdoers; Mahama will protect no one – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey says President John Mahama will shield no one who engages in wrongdoing, including members of the governing party.

results.title: NDC risks digging its own grave by repeating NPP’s mistakes – Fifi Kwetey
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey has warned that the party risks digging its own grave if it repeats the mistakes voters rejected under the NPP.

results.title: GIS trains 146 officers to strengthen firearms accountability
results.content: The Ghana Immigration Service (GIS) has trained 146 officers in weapon safety and armoury management in a move to strengthen accountability in the handling, storage and tracking of firearms and ammunition.

results.title: Samuel Abu Jinapor writes on Tuesday’s incident in Parliament
results.content: At Tuesday’s sitting of Parliament, I raised serious and disturbing allegations concerning the alleged sale of Ghanaian diplomatic passports for amounts ranging from US$10,000 to US$50,000. In my capacity as Ranking Member of Parliament’s Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration Committee, I called for the Minister for Foreign Affairs to appear before Parliament and account for these allegations.

results.title: SDA Church steps in to rescue overstretched Wa Municipal Hospital from environmental crisis
results.content: The Wa Municipal Hospital has received a critical environmental intervention from the Seventh-day Adventist (SDA) Church to combat health risks amid severe labour shortages at the facility.

results.title: Singapore Airlines says 46,000 booking records affected by Amadeus breach
results.content: Singapore Airlines said on Tuesday that about 46,000 booking records may have been affected by ​a cybersecurity incident involving Amadeus its reservation technology ‌provider.

results.title: NDC admits error in clearing Obuasi SHTS headmaster amid abuse allegations
results.content: The General Secretary of the NDC, Fifi Kwetey, has acknowledged that the party mishandled its initial response to sexual abuse allegations against the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), saying it should have waited for further evidence before taking a position.

results.title: Cybersecurity gaps could expose Traffitech users to fraud — Technology Consultant
results.content: Technology consultant Maximus Amertogoh has called on the Ghana Police Service to strengthen cybersecurity safeguards around its newly introduced Traffitech-GH system, warning that uncertainty over official notification channels could expose motorists to fraud.

results.title: Why Kim Kardashian came back to ‘the worst TV drama ever’
results.content: It was meant to be Kim Kardashian's triumphant debut as a leading actor - but last year's legal drama All's Fair was so universally panned by critics that it actually broke streaming records as audiences clambered to see what all the fuss was about.

results.title: TCL urges TV buyers to look beyond the ‘Mini LED’ label
results.content: TCL, the world’s largest Mini LED television brand, is encouraging consumers across West Africa to look beyond the “Mini LED” label when shopping for a television and pay closer attention to three features that can significantly influence picture quality.
